# Master Service Agreement — Fixture Foods, Inc.

## 1. Parties
This Agreement is between Ridgeline Freight, LLC and Fixture Foods, Inc.

Ridgeline Freight, LLC
1432 Quarrystone Avenue
Chicago, IL 60632

## 2. Term

### 2.1 Effective Date
This Agreement is effective 04/01/2026.

### 2.2 Renewal
This Agreement renews for successive one-year terms unless either party gives 60 days written notice.

## 3. Payment
The Customer pays each invoice Net 30, except that disputed amounts are payable within 15 days of resolution.

1. Invoices are issued on delivery.
   - Each invoice lists the accessorial charges.
   - Each invoice names the lane.
2. Late amounts accrue a charge of 2% per month.
